title: Release Train Bidirectional Parity
goal: Enforce upstream-first Dev/UAT/Main cross-sync, resolve migration and code collisions on Dev, stamp sequential Calendar Release Trains, and verify the 4-dimension Environment Parity Matrix.
deliverables: Upstream-first back-sync receipt on Dev (when upstream was ahead)
Post-deploy live cloud provenance and capability flag verification
impact_fields: Code parity counts before and after sync
Schema watermarks and resolved migration collisions
Live runtime capability flags across Dev, UAT, and Production
common_failures: cherry-picking commits from dev to uat instead of merging after upstream-first back-sync
leaving colliding migration sequence numbers unresolved across dev and uat
landing feature code to uat while cloud capability flags or gateway services stay disabled
mutating accepted uat or main migration files instead of re-sequencing dev-only migrations
